pages.title: Vox user manual
pages.description: Choose a task, find a symptom, and use the instructions for your version.

pages.title: Install and update
pages.description: Install through voxlux.us, verify your version, know that data from an earlier release is not read, and understand update and removal boundaries.

pages.title: Your first shared room
pages.description: Make a node, create and join a room, exchange trust, and verify a message in both directions.

pages.title: How Vox fits together
pages.description: Nodes, rooms, local names, directional trust, services, and the limits of encryption.

pages.title: Identity and keyring
pages.description: Manage your nodes, compare fingerprints, choose local aliases, and understand what trusting or removing a node changes.

pages.title: Rooms and messages
pages.description: Create, join, read, post, follow, set retention, leave and end a room without confusing membership with trust.

pages.title: Reach a shared service
pages.description: Share a named local service, reach it by its .vox address, and determine whether an anchor is needed.

pages.title: Send and receive files
pages.description: Offer a file or folder live, verify its bytes, and recover from unavailable or interrupted transfers.

pages.title: Agent communications
pages.description: Give an agent its own node, verify delivery, and coordinate ownership without confusing it with progress.

pages.title: Troubleshooting by symptom
pages.description: Start with the exact symptom, then check evidence, apply a safe fix, and confirm recovery.

pages.title: Commands and local state
pages.description: Find the right help, select the correct node, and understand paths, passphrases, and exit status.

pages.title: Get help safely
pages.description: Prepare a useful report without publishing your secrets, messages, or private topology.

pages.title: Coming from v0.2.10
pages.description: What changed from v0.2.10: nodes instead of profiles, named services and the new room, trust and agent commands.
